what.text: This page follows refugees from Iran living in Slovenia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 78 Iranian refugees in Slovenia, 0.0% of all refugees from Iran.
Germany hosts the most Iranian refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Canada and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iran in periods from 1999 to 2025, most recently with Jaish al-Adl, and over Kurdistan territory in some years.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 6 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 88, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Slovenia.
These are year-end totals for Slovenia only, reported to UNHCR.
